title: Mana before Life
wikitext:
'''Mana before Life''' is a [[game mechanic]] that allows [[mana]] to be used to take damage, increasing effective health.

__TOC__

==Mechanics==
When [[taking damage]], a percentage of damage that would be dealt to the defender's [[life]] is deducted from mana instead. If the character has insufficient current mana to fully take the damage to mana, then the remainder of the damage will be taken to life instead. This effect occurs after almost all other forms of avoidance and mitigation.

Damage taken to [[energy shield]] has no interaction with this stat<ref>http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/545810/page/1#p4929196</ref>. However, with [[Eldritch Battery]], the damage taken from mana before life will be taken from energy shield first instead. Chaos damage will still bypass energy shield this way.

Although taking mana before life does increase effective health, it does not cause mana to affect the player's thresholds for [[ailment]]s or [[stun]].<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/545810/page/4#p6563071</ref>

Having sufficient mana recovery is required to prevent rapid hits or [[damage over time]] from continually draining mana, preventing skill usage.

This effect is capped at 100%. Having more than 100% of damage taken from Mana before Life will not cause you to lose more Mana than you were to take to Life.

===Mana/Life ratio===
For [[mana]] to not run out before [[life]], the unreserved mana should be at least {{#expr: 0.4/(1-0.4)*100 round 0}}% of unreserved life, granted that 40% of damage is taken from mana before life. Other ratios can be found using the following formula. Note that this only applies to a single hit and does not take into account other forms of recovery or damage prevention.

{{cot|Derivation of the mana/life ratio}}

Let {{math|display=inline|formula=k = {X \over 100} }} be the proportion of damage taken from mana before life.  To completely remove all mana, the damage, {{math|dmg}}, has to be:

{{math
|formula = mana - (k \times dmg) = 0
|display = block
|ref = {{EquationRef|1}}
}}

To completely remove all life:

{{math
|formula = life - (1-k) \times dmg = 0
|display = block
|ref = {{EquationRef|2}}
}}

Solving equation {{EquationNote|1}} for {{math|dmg}}:

{{math
|formula = dmg = {mana \over k}
|display = block
|ref = {{EquationRef|3}}
}}

{{EquationNote|3}} in {{EquationNote|2}} gives:

{{math
|formula = life - (1-k) \times {mana \over k} = 0
|display = block
|ref = {{EquationRef|4}}
}}

Solving {{EquationNote|4}} for {{math|mana}}:

{{math
|formula = mana = {k \over 1-k} \times life
|display = block
|ref = {{EquationRef|5}}
}}

The ratio {{math|display=inline|formula={mana \over life} = {k \over 1-k} }} leads to exactly all life and mana being removed from a one-shot. 
If the ratio is less, i.e. {{math|display=inline|formula={mana \over life} < {k \over 1-k} }}, then mana will have run out before all life is removed.

==Related legacy modifiers==
These modifiers can only be obtained in [[permanent league]]s as a legacy modifier.

{{Query spawnable modifiers
|q_where=(mods.stat_text LIKE "%Damage%taken%from%Mana%Before%Life%" 
OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%Mind%Over%Matter%")
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Sanctum%" 
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Charm%"
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Unique%"  
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%ChargeBonusMindOverMatterPowerCharges%" 
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%ClarityDamageTakenFromManaBeforeLife%"
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%DamageRemovedFromManaBeforeLifeTestMod%"  
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%ManaShield%"  
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}

==Related items==
===Unique items===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
    items.stat_text LIKE "%Mind%Over%Matter%" 
 OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Damage%taken%from%Mana%Before%Life%" 
 OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Random%Keystone%"
 OR items.name LIKE "%Watcher's Eye%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

{{c|foulborn|Foulborn}} {{il|Mind of the Council}} can grant {{c|foulborn|30% of Physical Damage is taken from Mana before Life}}.

The legacy unique {{il|That Which Was Taken}} can also roll with a modifier that grants {{c|mod|3% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life}}.

==Related passives skills==
{{Query passive skills
|q_where=
    passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Mind%Over%Matter%" 
 OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Damage%taken%from%Mana%Before%Life%" 
 OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Random%Keystone%"
|ascendancy=1
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.19.0|
* The Mind over Matter Keystone Passive Skill now causes 40% of Damage to be taken from Mana before Life (previously 30%).
* Damage taken from Mana before Life can no longer roll as an Influence modifier, Synthesised Implicit modifier, or Eldritch Implicit modifier on Body Armour.
* The Cloak of Defiance Unique Body Armour no longer has 10% of Damage is Taken from Mana before Life.
* The Veiled modifier that grants Damage taken from Mana before Life while Focused now provides values of 18–22% (previously 28–32%). The crafted versions of this modifier now provide values of 11–15% (previously 21–25%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.0.0|
* Now applies to Damage over Time as well as Hits.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.0|
* Introduced to the game. 
}}
{{Version history table end}}
